summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, to report a press release announcing positive symptom response data from its ongoing Phase 1b/2a RESOLVE trial. The data concern EP-104GI in eosinophilic esophagitis, showing reductions in moderate-to-severe odynophagia and dysphagia from baseline to weeks 24 and 52, with no serious adverse events in over 130 patients. There is no transactional event, no deal terms, and no mention of M&A or capital markets activity. This is a routine clinical data disclosure by a clinical-stage biotech, not a special situation.
